exposure: Maximum oxytocin dose > 20 mu/min vs. ≤ 20 mu/min
cohort: Term pregnant women who reached the second stage of labor at a single center between 2004 and 2008.
finding: Maternal diabetes, birth weight > 4000 g, intrapartum fever, administration of magnesium, and induction of labor were independently associated with higher maximum oxytocin doses during labor.
